stereochemical_evidence.summary: Enantiomers resolved by HPLC on a Chiralart Cellulose SC column; elution order and ee are reported.
[alpha]D25 +3803 (c 0.160, CHCl3) for E1 and -3610 (c 0.154, CHCl3) for E2.
The article states that synthesis and X-ray structure were reported previously; verify the cited synthesis paper before treating this as an absolute-configuration assignment for the measured samples.
The two enantiomers give nearly mirror-image experimental ECD spectra.
stereochemical_evidence.interpretation_limit: Supports enantiomeric relationship but is not, by itself, an independent absolute-configuration assignment.
